name: WASP-87
description: Star of 6,450 K, 298 parsecs away, with 1 transiting planet.

radius.source: Addison et al. 2016, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of WASP-87 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive

mass.source: Addison et al. 2016, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of WASP-87 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive

temperature.source: Addison et al. 2016, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of WASP-87 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive

color.reason: a companion 8.1 arcsec away gives 12% of the light (WDS 12213-5250, Mason et al. 2001) and blends into its measured spectra and catalogue colors, so the color is taken from its own temperature

text.card: WASP-87 b crosses WASP-87 as seen from Earth, which is how it was found.
text.introduction: Its radius and temperature follow Addison et al. 2016.
